nodes.name: When Executed by Parent Workflow
nodes.notes: Entry point when a parent workflow calls this one. Set to passthrough: the calling nodes in the catalog declare no input fields, so whatever the parent emits arrives here unchanged.

nodes.name: Apply 'bug' Handling
nodes.notes: Normalises the routed ticket and records which switch arm handled them. Add the 'bug'-specific work here - this is the extension point the parent's switch was built around.

nodes.name: Return Handled Ticket
nodes.notes: Returns to the parent's Merge Routed Work node, which appends this arm's items alongside the others. `status` is set for consistency with the Post-Process libs; the branch callers only read the error rail.

parameters.content:

Entry point. Receives only the ticket the parent's switch sent down the 'bug' arm.

Next: Apply 'bug' Handling

nodes.name: Note: When Executed by Parent Workflow

parameters.content:
### Apply 'bug' Handling

Normalises the items and tags `route: 'bug'`.

🛠 This is where 'bug'-specific logic goes.

Next: Return Handled Ticket

### Return Handled Ticket

Writes `status`, `handledBy`, `route`, then returns to the parent's Merge Routed Work.

## lib: Process Bug Ticket

The 'bug' arm of a parent's **Route by Work Type** switch, for ticket. Shipped as a working passthrough so the branch completes end to end; the branch-specific rules are yours to add.

**Called by:** parent templates that reference `lib: Process Bug Ticket` in an Execute Workflow or Workflow Tool node.

nodes.name: Note: lib: Process Bug Ticket overview

parameters.content:
### Contract

**In:** the ticket the switch routed to 'bug'. No fields required.

**Out:** the same items with `route`, `handledBy` and `status` added, appended by the parent's Merge Routed Work node. Callers read only the error rail, so any additional field you add here flows on untouched.

nodes.name: Note: lib: Process Bug Ticket contract

parameters.content:
### Credentials setup

**None.** This lib calls nothing external, so it runs as imported.

nodes.name: Note: lib: Process Bug Ticket credentials

parameters.content:
### Troubleshooting

**The branch does nothing useful yet.** By design - the parents establish that 'bug' is routed separately, but none of them documents what should happen to it. Put that logic in the Apply 'bug' Handling node.

**Items appear twice after the merge.** The parent's Merge Routed Work is in append mode across all arms; check the switch is not sending the same item down two arms.

nodes.name: Note: lib: Process Bug Ticket troubleshooting
